title: After he died, it’s like I blacked out. My mom says I …
text:
After he died, it’s like I blacked out. My mom says I … Rumors News & Analysis Salaries Player Rankings NBA 2K Rankings Free Agency NBA RUMORS After he died, it’s like I blacked out. My mom says I …
 HoopsHype Nov. 5, 2026, 3:22 p.m. ET Ayo Dosunmu: I carried that mantra with me the whole way. It went from “What do you wanna be when you grow up?” To ……. “I’m playing in the league. Period. You can laugh, but I’m not laughing.” After he died, it’s like I blacked out. My mom says I used to come home from school and it went from my dad being like “You gotta get your work in” to it being a blizzard outside and me putting on my hat and gloves and getting a shovel and plowing a little lane on the corner 3 and shooting for hours. I’m an imaginer. I used to be imagining the middle school gyms I’d be in next, and the kids I’d be playing against, and just going off for 30, 40, 50 .
